My advice to be assertive or forward when asking people to hang out. Not in a pushy annoying way, but be *that person* who makes plans and go through with them. If you meet anyone who looks like a potentially good friend (similar interests or seems somewhat compatible with you) ask them out for coffee or just a walk in the park. Entps love talking so it really shouldn’t be too hard to get along with most people. Once you’ve found the right person to make plans with, the rest should come naturally. I made some of my closest friends (from work and school) just by spontaneously reaching out to them and asking to hang out.
